title: Marlowe & Finch Unlimited Benefit Schedule — Made-to-Order Remake Deposit Reduction
content:
**Benefit.** On a remake of a cancelled Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Made-to-Order pair, a Marlowe & Finch Unlimited plan held by a Marlowe Rewards member of Gold tier or above takes percentage points off the remake deposit percentage before that percentage is applied to the price:

| Marlowe & Finch Unlimited plan | Marlowe Rewards membership | Points off the remake deposit percentage |
|---|---|---|
| Active annual plan: Unlimited Standard Annual, Unlimited Express Annual, Unlimited Next-Day Annual or Unlimited Student Annual | Active Gold, Platinum, Icon or Atelier | 5 |
| Active monthly plan: Unlimited Standard Monthly or Unlimited Express Monthly | Active Gold, Platinum, Icon or Atelier | 2 |
| Any other customer, including an Unlimited member below Gold | — | 0 |

**Records read.** The customer's Marlowe & Finch Unlimited plan, meaning which plan it is and whether it is active, and the customer's Marlowe Rewards membership, meaning the tier and whether it is active. Both conditions of a row must hold together.

**Combinations (hypothetical customers)**

| Unlimited plan | Marlowe Rewards | Points off |
|---|---|---|
| Unlimited Express Annual, active | Platinum, active | 5 |
| Unlimited Standard Monthly, active | Icon, active | 2 |
| Unlimited Student Annual, active | Silver, active | 0 |
| Unlimited Next-Day Annual, not active | Gold, active | 0 |
| None | Atelier, active | 0 |
| Unlimited Standard Annual, active | Gold, suspended | 0 |

The points are percentage points. For example, 5 points take a remake deposit percentage of 50 down to 45.
